post_text:
Just shipped the first version of our AI agent.
It can now browse docs, use tools, and recover from failed actions without restarting the whole run.
Still rough, but seeing it work end-to-end is crazy.
We just launched our first AI agent into production. The demo worked, but retries, permissions and failure recovery turned out to be the real work.
Companies are preparing for new AI transparency requirements, but most still don't know where AI is actually being used.
comment: The hard part is building a durable run record that flags every place an LLM touches data and who can stop it.

post_text: We're giving our AI agents more tools and more autonomy. The main question is how much autonomy they should have before asking a human.
comment: Defining the stopping condition is the hard part, not adding another tool.
